description: This file contains unit tests for the CountryDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to country and province data retrieval within the OrangeHRM Admin module.

classes.name: CountryDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CountryDao data access object, focusing on country and province data retrieval methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the CountryDao object and loading test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of countries, verifying count and correctness of data.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of province list for a given country code, verifying count and data accuracy.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a country by its name, including cases where the country does not exist.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a country by its code, including non-existing code case.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a province by its code, including non-existing code case.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a province by its name, including non-existing name case.
